meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Black Friday Web Hosting Deals 2026: Checked Offers
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Black Friday web hosting deals for 2026: offers read on each host's own page on 15 Nov, with renewal prices, end dates, AI features and hosts with no sale.
meta.rl_answer: Black Friday 2026 is on 27 November. Hostinger, hosting.com, ScalaHosting, Kinsta and Cloudways list sales on their own pages. Compare the renewal price, not only the sale price.

meta.rl_l_method:
Host pages only | We read each offer on the host's own page and show the date we read it.
No test scores | We did not test these hosts, so there are no scores. Where a third party tested a host, we name it, the date and the method.
Renewal price shown | We show the renewal price next to the sale price, because that is where the real cost sits.
meta.rl_l_cta_head: Moving a live site to a new host?
meta.rl_l_cta_sub: Reinforce Lab can copy, test and switch your WordPress site without lost rankings.
meta.rl_takeaways:
Black Friday is 27 November 2026 and Cyber Monday is 30 November.
Compare the renewal price, not only the sale price.
Hostinger runs to 14 Dec, hosting.com to 14 Dec, ScalaHosting to 1 Dec and Kinsta to 1 Dec.
BigScoots, Namecheap and DigitalOcean had no Black Friday sale when we checked.
meta.rl_faqs:
When is Black Friday 2026? | Black Friday is on 27 November 2026, the day after US Thanksgiving. Cyber Monday is on 30 November.
Are Black Friday web hosting deals worth it? | They can be, if you can accept the term and the renewal price. Check the price you will pay after the first term, and the money-back window.
Do Black Friday hosting prices apply when I renew? | Usually not. The sale price covers the first term. The host's page shows the renewal price, which is often several times higher.
Can I use a Black Friday deal on a host I already use? | Often not. Kinsta limits its offer to new customers, and ScalaHosting limits its offer to new plans and upgrades.
Which host has the lowest Black Friday price? | hosting.com lists the lowest sale prices here, from $1.49 a month on a 12-month plan, but it also has the biggest renewal jump.
Which of these hosts list AI features? | Hostinger, hosting.com, Cloudways, ScalaHosting and Spaceship list AI features on their pages. We have not tested them.
How long do Black Friday hosting deals last? | It varies. In the pages we read, offers ended on 1 December (ScalaHosting, Kinsta) or 14 December (Hostinger, hosting.com). Cloudways showed no end date.
